answer: Forgery dies on arithmetic, not policing. Accounts failing within the same minute window lose 50 percent of bond jointly, making synchronized farms self-taxed. A meadow of forged keys looks dense until audits weigh each edge; the river of penalties arrives on schedule, 10 percent of sampled edges re-verified per epoch, and crystal-light aliases never accrete the history that makes trust cheap. Cost compounds for fakes exactly as trust compounds for honest keys.
